product_family: Web-based PDF productivity suite (compress, convert, merge, edit, e-sign) with an added AI PDF Assistant (chat with PDF, summarize, translate, question generation) and Sign.com for e-signature workflows. Consumer, Pro, and Team pricing tiers on the same platform.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2013
certifications.proof_quote: We comply with the globally accepted ISO/IEC accreditation for applying an information security management system (ISO 27001:2013).

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Smallpdf is ISO/IEC 27001 certified and GDPR, CCPA, and nFADP compliant.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Smallpdf is ISO/IEC 27001 certified and GDPR, CCPA, and nFADP compliant.

certifications.name: nFADP (Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: Smallpdf is ISO/IEC 27001 certified and GDPR, CCPA, and nFADP compliant.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I/II)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a SOC 2 report on vendor domain; trust center and homepage list ISO 27001, GDPR, CCPA, and nFADP only, with no mention of SOC 2.

certifications.name: HIPAA / BAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement offering on vendor domain; independent reviews note Smallpdf's standard tiers do not provide a BAA and PHI should not be uploaded.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification found on vendor domain (payment processing is not a described product feature).

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017, 27018, or 27701 on vendor domain; only ISO 27001:2013 is referenced.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of AI governance certification on vendor domain, despite Smallpdf offering an AI PDF Assistant product.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or CSA STAR AI attestation found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on vendor domain; not relevant to this consumer/SMB product's stated market.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor homepage and blog make no reference to AI training at all. Treat as probable but not fully vendor-quote-verified; re-check the live privacy notice before using this as a hard claim.
privacy.data_region: EU (Ireland) for file processing infrastructure, per vendor blog: server infrastructure falls under EU data protection law.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: 256-bit TLS encryption for file transfer, described by the vendor as 'the same encryption used by banks'.

security.name: File retention / deletion
security.value: Files uploaded to free tools are deleted from servers after 1 hour of processing; files saved to account storage are kept until the user deletes them, removed within 1 hour of a deletion request.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Vendor states only the account owner can view, edit, or access uploaded files unless explicit permission is granted to others.

security.name: Data residency
security.value: Server infrastructure located in Ireland, under EU data protection law.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Vendor publishes a security.txt contact for reporting security issues (security@smallpdf.com).

products.name: Smallpdf Free / Pro (consumer)
products.category: PDF conversion, compression, merge, edit, e-sign
products.data_scope: User-uploaded PDFs and derived files, processed transiently and deleted within 1 hour unless saved to account storage.
products.notes: Same infrastructure and compliance posture as Team tier; no separate hardened offering documented.

products.name: Smallpdf Team
products.data_scope: Same as consumer tier, plus shared team file storage and admin controls.
products.notes: No evidence of a distinct enterprise-grade compliance tier (e.g. dedicated BAA, SOC 2 report) beyond the standard ISO 27001 / GDPR posture.

products.name: AI PDF Assistant
products.category: AI features: chat with PDF, summarize, translate, question generation
products.data_scope: Uploaded document content is processed by AI to generate summaries/answers; vendor-adjacent sources state files are not retained for AI training or manual review, but this could not be independently re-confirmed with a first-hand vendor quote in this session (see privacy.ai_training_note).
products.notes: No AI-governance certification (ISO 42001, CSA STAR AI) found despite this being an AI-driven product line.

products.name: Sign.com
products.category: Standalone e-signature product, linked from Smallpdf's Sign PDF tool

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free tools with limits, Pro (~EUR 7.50/mo/user annual) and Team (~EUR 6.00/mo/user annual, 2-100 seats) subscriptions.
compare.data_residency: EU (Ireland-based server infrastructure per vendor statement)

flags: No SOC 2 report found on vendor domain; only ISO 27001 is documented, which is common for a growth-stage consumer/SMB tool but should be disclosed as a gap, not assumed absent by omission alone.
No HIPAA/BAA offering found; independent reviews explicitly warn against uploading PHI. AIFOXX should not list this vendor as HIPAA-suitable.
AI PDF Assistant is a meaningful product line with no AI-specific governance certification (ISO 42001, CSA STAR AI) - flag as a gap given growing scrutiny of AI data handling.

The 'no AI training on customer data' claim is well-corroborated by multiple independent secondary sources describing Smallpdf's own privacy notice, though not by a first-hand quote from a live render of https://smallpdf.com/privacy.
